newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Commonwealth Bank to buy research co stake.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth Bank to buy research co stake.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday it planned to take a 50 percent equity stake in investment research company IPAC Securities.

Commonwealth Bank chairman David Murray said the acquisition, through Commonwealth Financial Services, would provide significant returns through access to the high-growth portfolio management and independent financial advice sector.

"We recognise the growing demand for sophisticated and independent financial advisory services and expect dividends from an equity investment in this area of strong growth," Murray said in a statement.
The two would examine potential areas for cooperation while maintaining IPAC's independence, the statement said.
IPAC Securities provides research and portfolio management for individuals and institutions on investment markets and securities managers.
The deal allows IPAC Securities to operate independently from the Commonwealth and to retain its existing management.
"There are enormous opportunities in Australia and overseas for independent, high quality research-based financial advisory and management services," IPAC executive chairman Arun Abey said.
